name: Custom Shape Plush Pillow
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from soft Velboa fabric, offering a plush, smooth, and comfortable touch.
    - Filled with polyester fiberfill that provides soft, elastic support for lasting comfort and shape retention.
    - Designed with an invisible zipper for a neat and seamless finished look.
    - Made in a custom shape to match your personalized design while remaining soft and huggable.
    - Lightweight yet cozy, making it suitable for both decorative and everyday use.
    - Your designs are printed on white fabric, so the default edge of the pillow will be white.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple size options (laid flat):
                +) 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
                +) 14 x 14 in ~ 35.56 x 35.56 cm
                +) 16 x 16 in ~ 40.64 x 40.64 cm
                +) 18 x 18 in ~ 45.72 x 45.72 cm
                +) 20 x 20 in ~ 50.8 x 50.8 cm
                +) 24 x 24 in ~ 60.96 x 60.96 cm
    📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be a ±1–2 cm size difference.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality full-surface heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - The product will have a white border by default.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative pillow and a soft plush companion.
    - Designed for use on beds, sofas, reading corners, nurseries, classrooms, playrooms, and cozy home spaces.
    - Soft fabric and plush filling make it comfortable for hugging, leaning, and cuddling.
    - Suitable for decorative display, nap support, room styling, and personalized keepsake use.
    - Perfect for adding a fun, warm, and customized touch to any room.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for kids, family members, friends, students, teachers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, back-to-school gifts, holidays, baby showers, classroom gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for children’s rooms, nursery décor, school-themed gifts, and personalized keepsakes.
    - A meaningful gift for anyone who loves cute, soft, and customized home accessories.
    - Great for decorative room accents, bedtime comfort, and memorable gift giving.
    - Adds a sweet, cozy, and personal touch to any space 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Plush Pillow

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
